ns3:Desc.ns3:DescText: DXB-CDG: Connect to WiFi on board to browse the Internet on your smartphone, tablet or laptop computer.

DXB-CDG: On your personal screen: movies, documentaries, TV shows and cartoons are available in 12 languages.

DXB-CDG: A power outlet is available for your seat to charge your electronic devices.
DXB-CDG: Download your favorite digital press onto your tablet or mobile free of charge, starting from 30 hours before your flight
